utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Gus, it’s looking good — Vik says turnout’s solid, and Sam’s set to be at the lot Saturday at 9 with a toolbox to help on the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great news—tell Sam I appreciate it, and I’ll bring my drill and extra screwdrivers for the small fixes at 9.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — thanks, Gus, that’ll really help, and I’ll let Sam know you’re bringing the drill and extra screwdrivers for 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting by the community shed at nine to sort tools, then we’ll split up; I’m bringing the extension cords and reminding everyone of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Eli—that’s the plan exactly, and once we sort the tools at nine by the community shed, we’ll split up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then I’ll be there a little before nine with the extension cords and I’ll keep reminding folks so we start on time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So far I’ve only heard of a few requests—some leaky faucets and a broken fence latch—and Sam said he’s ready to help, but I still need to confirm who can take plumbing or carpentry by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many requests is that exactly right now, and who’s updating the shared list so we can lock down plumbing and carpentry volunteers by tonight?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Exactly three that I know of right now—two leaky faucets and one fence latch—and I don’t know who’s updating the shared list yet, so I need to check with Rosa or the logistics folks next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Pia, just so you have the latest, the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center on Maple Street by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—I’m okay with that, but I’d still feel better once we’ve confirmed the headcount and got one shared tool list sorted before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia—I’m pulling the volunteer headcount together now, and I’ll send around one shared tool list for Sunday at the community center as soon as I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, thanks—meet by the community shed at nine, and if you can start helping set things up, that’d make things easier.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll be by the shed at nine and help with setup when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane—I appreciate it. We should be alright once the tools are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—Saturday at 10 works, and we’ll aim to wrap your part by about 2:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can come right after drop-off and stay until about 2:30 so I’m clear for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—thanks, Faye; I’m in too, and I’ll check with Leo or Opal on what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Leo, I’ve been telling everyone—Saturday at 10 in your driveway, and to bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Tess—please also ask folks to label anything they bring with their name so pickup stays simple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely, Leo—I’ll let everyone know to label whatever they bring with their name so pickup’s nice and easy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s still the repair drive by the community shed, but I’m waiting on Hana or Jules to confirm the time and who’s actually bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ve only been hearing second-hand too, so let me know if Hana or Jules confirm the time and tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I’m not sure on the volunteer count yet; Hana said it depends on whether Jules confirms a third repair for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren—let me know once Jules confirms, and for now we’re still meeting by the community shed this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Mara; I’ll check in once Jules confirms, and I can still help out at the shed even if I forgot my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, I’m still out running errands, but how’s the repair drive shaping up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s coming together, but I’m double-checking the details so I don’t tell you wrong—we’re meeting by the community shed at nine, and I still need to confirm which repairs are definitely on the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana—that helps. I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted once you’ve confirmed the repair list and tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but I want the headcount and tool list confirmed before we call it settled—can Opal or Leo verify who’s coming and what they’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive marked for Maple Street by the community garden, but I still need Leo to confirm headcount and who’s bringing which tools before I can call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then let’s hold off calling it settled until Leo or you can confirm the headcount and exactly who’s bringing what, okay?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in, Cleo—just tell me what needs fixing first and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—start with the loose fence panels, and let me know if you need anything besides the screws, tape, and gloves I’ve already got on hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll start on the loose fence panels now, and I’ll give you a shout if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in and ready to help, Bo—just tell me what needs fixing first and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—looks like it’s at Leo’s driveway this weekend, mostly small appliance and bike stuff, and I’m still waiting on the final list and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect—I’ll plan on Leo’s driveway this weekend and can jump in on bikes or small appliances; send me the final list when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, Uli: we’ll start at the shed with one shared list and a headcount, then set clear times so the repair drive stays orderly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that sounds right—we meet by the community shed at nine, count tools and people, then split once the list’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Exactly—that gives us a clean start, and once the list’s done we can send everyone where they’re needed without any muddle.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s picking up fast, Rosa—Saturday’s repair drive is turning into a real block effort, and I’m inviting everyone tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn—that’s wonderful, but it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so please share the updated spot and time when you invite folks tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center and send around the updated time with the invite tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still not sure on the full order, Oren, but separating the hand tools from the spare parts sounds like a good place to start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—that sounds sensible; I’ll keep sorting those, and I’ll ask around about Saturday once someone confirms the final repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren—that helps; if you hear what the first priority is, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say for sure, can we confirm whether it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and that we’re meeting by the community shed at nine?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: As far as I know, yes—it’s still the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and we’re meeting Sunday at nine by the community shed unless Rosa updates the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus—that matches what I’ve heard except for the day, since I had Saturday in mind, so I’ll hold off spreading it until we confirm whether it’s Saturday or Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane—we’re still set to meet by the community shed this weekend, and I’ve been keeping folks aligned on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear—thanks for keeping everyone lined up, Mara; I’ll catch up with the rest and make sure we’re ready by the shed this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules, it’s looking good—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear, Tess — thanks for locking it in and keeping the tools moving; I’ll help spread the word so the other folks know it’s set for Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Jules—that helps a ton, and if anyone asks, just tell them to bring whatever fix-it bits they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, how many repair requests are actually logged right now, and who’s updating the shared list before this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right now I’ve only heard about the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and I’m the one updating the shared list before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So that’s two logged right now—do both already have volunteer coverage, or is either still open?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pia, repair drive’s Saturday at 10 in my driveway; I’m meeting Eli by the community shed at 9 to sort tools first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Leo—I’ll feel a lot better if we’ve got the headcount confirmed and one shared tool list sorted at the shed before everyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call—can you confirm the headcount today, and I’ll bring the tool list to the shed at 9 so we can lock it in before 10.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, Cleo—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Latest is I’ve got screws, tape, and some gloves on hand, and Quinn wants to make it a full block event tonight if we can keep the supply list realistic.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds promising—if Quinn’s keeping the list realistic, I’m glad it’s picking up steam.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, I’m still out running errands, but how’s the repair drive shaping up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s shaping up well—I still have the repair drive on Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m planning to get there a little early to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good—that sounds solid. I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted once you’re there and let me know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you check with Hana and confirm the headcount and tool list before we call the repair drive settled?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, not settled yet—I still need to check with Hana and confirm the headcount and who’s bringing which tools first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, let me know once Hana confirms the headcount and who’s bringing which tools, and then we can call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Maple Street by the community garden, with the bench, fence panel, and Cedar bus stop light still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Opal—I’ll be there Saturday at 9 with my toolbox and start on the loose fence panel by the community garden first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Sam—I’ve got you down for Saturday at 9 starting with the loose fence panel by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help Sunday at the community center after school drop-off, as long as I’m free again by pickup around 2:45 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That timing works—thanks, Faye. I’m still tracking supplies, and right now we’ve definitely got spare screws, tape, and gloves on hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — I’ll plan to come by after drop-off on Sunday and head out again before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks—let’s wait on Jules to confirm the repair list, and I’ll still bring my toolbox Saturday in case I’m useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — just so we’re aligned, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, and your toolbox would still be a big help once Jules confirms the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—Sunday, right, thanks for catching me. I’ll bring the toolbox to the community center and wait on Jules before asking about more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say much, can we verify whether it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and that we’re meeting by the community shed at nine?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d double-check that first—I thought Leo’s driveway was the meetup, and I’m still waiting on the final fix list and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that matches what I was worried about, so let’s not repeat the shed or nine o’clock yet; I’ll confirm the meetup spot and whether it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence before we tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mara, the repair drive’s set for Sunday at the community center on Maple, and I can bring my drill plus a couple extra screwdrivers if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot, but we’re actually still meeting by the community shed this weekend, so bring the drill and screwdrivers there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it—I’ll bring the drill and extra screwdrivers to the community shed this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s still the repair drive by the shed, but I’m waiting on Hana or Jules to confirm the time and who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’m inviting folks tonight, and as soon as I lock down who’s coming and what tools they’ve got, I’ll send you the full list for Saturday by the shed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks—I think it’s still the repair drive by the shed, but I’m waiting on Hana or Jules to confirm the time before we call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Kira, we start at 9 by the community shed to sort tools, then shift to my driveway for the repair drive at 10.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are Jules and Vik definitely in too, and can you confirm the full headcount and tool list before we call this settled?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Jules and Vik aren’t confirmed on my end yet; confirmed so far are Bo, Opal, Eli, Sam, and Gus, with Eli bringing extension cords and Gus bringing a drill plus extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: First priority’s the shed at nine, and after that we’ll tackle the leaky faucets and that fence latch if the tools are all sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll pass along that the shed setup at nine comes first, then the faucets and fence latch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Exactly—that’s the plan I’ve been repeating, and if folks ask, tell them we still need the tools sorted before we move on to the faucets and fence latch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus says Sam and Uli are confirmed, and he’s handling the tool drop-off, but I still need a straight answer on who’s updating the shared list and whether Jules confirmed that third repair—do you know either one?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I don’t know for sure yet—Jules has been helping coordinate, but I still need to check on that third repair and who’s updating the shared list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, Ira—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so I haven’t heard much more yet—if you catch any new details, let me know how it’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do—I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but if Quinn or Hana shares anything solid, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m alright with Saturday at 10, but I still want the headcount confirmed and one shared tool list at the shed before we call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds fair — I’m still waiting on the final headcount, and I’ll make sure we’ve got one shared tool list at the shed before I confirm Saturday at 10 to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules—that makes me feel better, but I’d still like the headcount in hand before we start telling people it’s fully set.
